svg.title: InsightPilot - evaluation and CI pipeline
svg.text: Test levels on every pull request · evaluation harness · release · periodic human evaluation
EVERY PULL REQUEST: GITHUB ACTIONS (ALL JOBS MUST PASS TO MERGE)
harness job runs on the same pull request
failing test or regression blocks the merge
EVALUATION HARNESS: ON EVERY PULL REQUEST AND NIGHTLY
all jobs green: merge and release
PERIODIC HUMAN EVALUATION: NOT IN CI
KEY: Solid arrow = the run proceeds; dashed arrow = feedback. Cards run left to right within a lane. B1 = verifier-off baseline (Table 12).
Requirements: FR-01, FR-02 and NFR-14 (harness in CI on every pull request); NFR-13 and FR-27 (quickstart); NFR-09 and NFR-10 (human studies).
